visualCharacteristics: Edge-to-edge row of 4 tall portrait image tiles with no gutter-padding, entire tile linked, single uppercase white label at the bottom over the image.
contentPattern: Four look-alike linked image tiles that wrap responsively, each linking to a detail page: Cards.
usage: Edge-to-edge row of tall image tiles, each fully linked with a short label over the image.
reuseGuidance: Use for audience/segment navigation tiles (image + single label link). Author the label as a link; the whole tile becomes clickable. For cards with eyebrow, description and CTA use cards-overlay.

blockStructure.source: get_block_details /block-collection/cards (container; child model 'card': image, imageAlt, text)

cells: Rich text: eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link

blockStructure.notes: rc6 tile images are CSS background-images on the anchor wrappers (not in cleaned.html); the importer must read the computed background-image. The whole tile is a link: put label as link in text cell.
